name: Mendil
author: 30628206+ulaski@users.noreply.github.com
description: Mendil: a music bot for TeamSpeak 3 and 6 servers. People type !play with a song, a YouTube link or a Spotify link in the channel chat, and Mendil plays it in the voice channel. Queue, internet radio, admin and listener roles, and a web panel on this server's port. Uses Mendil's native engine (x86_64 and ARM64). Docs: https://ulaski.github.io/mendil/guides/pterodactyl/

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Mendil ships in its container image; the server folder only holds its data.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.ts3client /mnt/server/cache
echo "Mendil is ready. Set the TeamSpeak server address and start it."

variables.name: TeamSpeak server
variables.description: Address of your TeamSpeak server: host name, IP or host:port. It must be reachable from this node.

variables.name: TeamSpeak voice port
variables.description: Voice port of the TeamSpeak server.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: Only if your TeamSpeak server has a password.

variables.name: Channel
variables.description: Channel to join, by name or path (Games/Music). Empty means the default channel.

variables.name: Channel password
variables.description: Only if that channel has a password.

variables.name: Admin unique IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated TeamSpeak unique IDs of admins (type !whoami in TeamSpeak to see yours). Leave both admin fields empty and everyone is an admin.

variables.name: Admin groups
variables.description: Comma-separated server group IDs of admins.

variables.name: Web panel password
variables.description: Admin password for the web panel, which listens on this server's port. Empty: one is generated on first start and printed in the console.

variables.name: Radio stations
variables.description: Internet radio for when the queue is empty, as name=stream address, comma-separated.

variables.name: Radio station
variables.description: A station name or stream address that plays whenever the queue is empty.
